From there you can export a CSV and set a custom date range that covers the quarter you’re interested in. arguments.message: Sure! To pull the usage for the last quarter, go to **Settings → Billing → Usage**. From there you can export a CSV and set a custom date range that covers the quarter you’re interested in. If the export is larger than 10 000 records, narrow the range (e.g., export one month at a time) and combine the files later. That will give you the historical usage data for the last quarter.
